question: According to the Alma-Ata Declaration 1978, which of the following is one of the eight essential elements of Primary Health Care?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. 'Provision of essential drugs' is explicitly listed as one of the eight essential elements of PHC in the Alma-Ata Declaration.

answers.text: Construction of tertiary care hospitals in rural areas

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Building tertiary hospitals is not an element of PHC. PHC focuses on community-level promotive, preventive, and basic curative care — not specialist hospital infrastructure.

answers.text: Training of specialist physicians for district deployment

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. PHC focuses on training and using community health workers, not deploying specialist physicians. This reflects selective PHC approaches that deviate from Alma-Ata's comprehensive vision.
Incorrect. Health insurance schemes are a financing mechanism, not one of the eight essential elements. The Alma-Ata Declaration addresses service delivery components, not insurance architecture.

overallFeedback.feedback: Remember the 8 PHC elements from Alma-Ata: education on health problems, food supply and nutrition, safe water and sanitation, MCH including family planning, immunisation, endemic disease control, essential medicines, and appropriate treatment of common diseases.
Excellent. The eight Alma-Ata elements cover education, nutrition, water/sanitation, MCH/family planning, immunisation, endemic disease control, essential medicines, and treatment of common diseases.
